raw_segments.text: And yet he could not be quit of the past, of all that he had left behind and that tortured
He felt that miserably, and the thought of it sank into his heart with despair.
There was one moment when he felt an impulse to stop Andri, to jump out of the cart, to
pull out his loaded pistol, and to make an end of everything without waiting for the
But that moment flew by like a spark.
The horses galloped on, devouring space, and as he drew near his goal, again the thought
of her, of her alone, took more and more complete possession of his soul, chasing away the fearful
images that had been haunting it.
Oh, how he longed to look upon her, if only for a moment, if only from a distance.
